description: [Private query, public score] Check a public MCP URL for risky tools, permissions and changes, or call with {} for the full dossier sample and current offers. paymentTxHash.description: Optional. Base USDC tx hash: 0.02 USDC = extra check after 5 free/day, 0.25 USDC = full 7-question dossier with Ed25519 seal.

serverUrl.description: Public https URL of the MCP server to check. Omit to see the free sample preview.
